utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning, everybody in and around the courtroom. This is case number IT-08-91-T, the Prosecutor versus Mico Stanisic, and Stojan Zupljanin.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Registrar. Good morning to everyone. May we have the appearances today, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Joanna Korner and Crispian Smith for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Slobodan Zecevic, Slobodan Cvijetic, Eugene O'Sullivan appearing for Stanisic Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRGOVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Dragan Krgovic, Igor Pantelic, Aleksandar Aleksic, and Jason Antley appearing for Zupljanin Defence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Thank you. As I indicated when we adjourned --

utterances.speaker: MS. NIKOLIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Jelena Nikolic representing Witness T-25 [as interpreted]. Good morning.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: My apologies. My line of sight was --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Yes, as I indicated when we adjourned yesterday, we have a brief oral ruling to deliver this morning. Judge Delvoie.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. The Chamber is seized of the Prosecution's request for leave to amend its Rule 65 ter summary for Witness ST-195, filed confidentially on the 23rd of August, 2010. The Prosecution submits that when it interviewed ST-195 after the filing of the 65 ter summary, it found out he could testify on other relevant issues inter alia the structural hierarchy of communications between SJB Skender Vakuf and CSB Banja Luka and meetings attended by the accused Zupljanin hereinafter collectively called "issues." The Defence filed a confidential joint response on the 26th of August opposing the Prosecution's request. The Chamber considers the issues prima facie relevant. Furthermore, they do not expand or modify the case against the accused. The Chamber notes, however that the Prosecution filed its 65 ter summary for ST-195 on the 8th of June, 2009, based on his statement and testimony before the BiH authorities. It interviewed him and got his statement only on the 8th and 9th of December, 2009. This request should have been filed sooner and not a mere week before ST-195's scheduled testimony. Nonetheless, despite the fact that the Prosecution has not shown due diligence, the Chamber finds that by disclosing ST-195's Prosecution statement, including the issues to Defence on the 3rd of February, 2010, the Defence have been on notice. The Chamber notes that this Prosecution statement has been available to the Defence for seven months. The Chamber is therefore not persuaded that -- by the Defence submission that granting the Prosecution's request will prejudice the accused's right to a fair trial because the Defence lacks the time and facilities to conduct their own investigations surrounding the issues. For the foregoing reasons and in the interests of justice, the Chamber hereby grants the request and allows the amendment to the 65 ter summary of ST-195.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Thank you, Judge Delvoie. And so we now go back into closed session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We're back in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: I see from the published calendar that we have afternoon sittings tomorrow and Thursday, and they're both in Courtroom III. So we adjourn to 2.15 tomorrow. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 1st day of September, 2010, at 2.15 p.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.20 p.m.,
